The test image shows a soybean field with scattered patches of yellow/orange-brown dying plants against an otherwise green canopy. Key observations:
- Irregular patches of yellowing/browning throughout the field
- Non-uniform distribution — some areas heavily affected, others green
- Yellowing appears to involve interveinal chlorosis at the plant level

Comparing with the SDS reference: The bottom-right panel of the SDS collage shows nearly identical field-level patchwork of yellowing plants scattered throughout a green canopy — matching the test image closely. SDS is known for appearing as irregular patches in fields with interveinal chlorosis/necrosis where veins remain green.
